commits.message: fix(docs): rich-explore review — Escape test can fail, card says when it quits, stale comments (rich-demos-k78j.s6s)

feat(docs): rich-explore runs in the card (rich-demos-k78j.s6s)

main.ts is the card's entry and browses fixture.ts's in-memory files;
node.ts, which npm run demo runs, browses the real file system. Every
import is by published name, and the shared FileSystem type is imported
from its own file so the card shows no unused capability tabs.

Escape no longer quits: in the card it is the first half of the way out
(Escape then Tab), so it ended the program on the way. q and Ctrl-C quit.

feat(docs): rich-template-bindings runs in the card (rich-demos-k78j.ebz) (#367)

* feat(docs): rich-template-bindings runs in the card (rich-demos-k78j.ebz)

main.ts is the entry for the card and npm run template-bindings; index.ts and
wire.ts are gone and app.ts imports the library, its template-bindings
subpath and both optional peers by their published names. card.json keeps
the 100x30 the iframe page drew at. A new e2e spec types into a template and
switches sections through the card.

* fix(docs): template-bindings card fits every section; PgUp/PgDn nav the browser lets through (rich-demos-k78j.ebz)
